claim.quote: The final setup started data taking in Gran Sasso in August 2000. The performance and the first results of the measurement with the final setup are discussed.

name: First Results from the HDMS experiment in the Final Setup
notes: The abstract states a measurement of performance and first results, not a limit; the paper's body also reports an exclusion plot slightly better than Heidelberg-Moscow at low WIMP masses.

summary.plain: First data from the final HDMS set-up, with an enriched germanium-73 crystal at the centre: how well the detector worked and what background it saw.
summary.technical: Final setup with an enriched 73Ge inner detector; data from February to September 2001 (the last 132.4 days, 26.74 kg d) with an anticoincidence background reduction factor of about 4.5 at 50-100 keV and a 5 keV threshold (body of the paper); a WIMP-nucleon limit is shown in a figure.

title: First Results from the HDMS experiment in the Final Setup
why_it_matters: Showed the nested-crystal design with an enriched 73Ge target working at LNGS, the basis for the later spin-dependent limit.
